events.title: Attack UKMTO #197 6 November 2026 UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 16NM east of Khasab, Oman. The Master of a Tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz outbound, has reported an explosion at the waterline, port side. The crew are safe and are accounted for. The tanker is still under its own power and is continuing on its voyage. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #196 5 November 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 50NM North of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar. A tanker has been struck by two unidentified projectiles. The status of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact are unconfirmed at present. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities continue to investigate.

Attack UKMTO #195 3 November 2026 UKMTO INCIDENT 195-26: UKMTO has received a report of an incident 14NM northeast of Lima, Oman. The Company Security Officer for a Tanker reports being struck by two unknown projectiles into the engine room. There are no casualties or environmental impact reported as this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #194 3 November 2026 20261103-UKMTO_WARNING 194-26 UKMTO is aware of a report by the Indian Government of an attack on an Indian crewed Dhow whilst sailing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz. The Omani Royal Navy have rescued the surviving crew. UKMTO is unaware of the status of the vessel. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #193 2 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 193-26. UKMTO has received a report of an incident 9NM northeast of Lima, Oman. The Master reports the vessel has been struck by an unknown projectile which has caused a hole on the starboard side. Vessel and crew safe, no environmental impact reported. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #192 2 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 192-2026. UKMTO has received a report of an incident 72NM east of RAS AL KHAFJI, SAUDI ARABIA. A tanker travelling southeast through the Arabian Gulf has been struck by 2 unknown projectiles on the port side. All crew are accounted for and there is no reported environmental impact at this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #191 1 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 191-2026. UKMTO has received a report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz. The Master of a merchant vessel has relayed a Mayday call from VHF Ch 16, stating that another vessel has been struck by an unknown projectile.
